localChanges: Isaac Newton's College now raises the science from every Library and University you own, until anyone discovers Nuclear Fission.
Hoover Dam now powers every city you have on its continent that has a Factory, as if each had its own power plant (closes #115).
With Michelangelo's Chapel, a Cathedral now makes six unhappy citizens content rather than eight, and J.S. Bach's Cathedral only calms your cities on its own continent, as in Civ1 (closes #236).
